A sketchy rumor is doing the rounds suggesting that Apple is working on a ceramic edition of the iPhone 20 Pro.

There are no details, and while one concept image reveals a ceramic back, this seems a rather unlikely possibility ….

It has been revealed that fixed Focus Digital is one of those pointing to the possibility, stating that they have seen ceramic components for next year’s flagship iPhone. An image has also been shared by Tech Overwatch, which is very clearly a render, simply imagining what it might look like.

Details are very vague, so it’s possible that the whole thing is a misunderstanding based on Apple’s Ceramic Shield protection for the display and glass back, as seen on the iPhone Air.

According to recent reports, given that the iPhone 20 Pro will itself be a very premium device and involve a completely new production line setup, it seems rather unlikely Apple would want to either launch a super-premium version or experiment with two different versions at the same time. 📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Google celebrates 15 years in Colombia with $1 million in Google.org funding for AI education, small businesses, rural youth, and disaster relief.

Country Director, Andean Region.

Your browser does not support the audio element.

Fifteen years ago, Google’s story in Colombia began with five people and a clear belief: technology is most meaningful when it serves people’s ideas, projects, and dreams.

According to recent reports, since opening our local office and launching YouTube in Colombia in 2011, we’ve grown together. Over the years, we’ve shared the journey with Colombians from their first search query to their latest prompt. We’ve introduced tools for everyday life and safety — like Android Earthquake Alerts, Google Wallet, Gemini, YouTube Kids and Family Link — and helped showcase local culture through Google Street View imagery across more than 51 cities and landmarks like the Coffee Cultural Landscape.

AI has the potential to spark new ideas and opportunities — and according to the AI Sprinters report, strong AI adoption could add between $7.2 billion and $13.6 billion annually to Colombia’s economy. Reaching that potential requires investing in people. Since 2019, Grow with Google has helped more than 13,500 Colombians graduate, including military veteran Jaime Olivera in Neiva, who trained in cybersecurity and now advises three companies as an ethical hacker.

To build on this momentum for our 15th anniversary, we’re announcing more than $1 million in Google.org funding across four areas:.

We’re proud to share our tools and research, but the vision and next significant idea will always come from you. Thank you for 15 years of building together.

GTA VI developers vote against unionization

📅 26 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 2 min read (371 words, 📖 Standard) | Source: The Verge

⏱️ ~2 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Workers voted 75 percent against the IWGB recognition agreement.
  • Workers voted 75 percent against the IWGB recognition agreement.
  • Workers at Grand Theft Auto VI developer Rockstar Games won’t unionize, after the vote for a formal recognition agreement failed, with only 25 percent of votes in favor of unionization.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Workers voted 75 percent against the IWGB recognition agreement.

Workers voted 75 percent against the IWGB recognition agreement.

Workers at Grand Theft Auto VI developer Rockstar Games won’t unionize, after the vote for a formal recognition agreement failed, with only 25 percent of votes in favor of unionization. The Independent Workers Union of Great Britain (IWGB) mentioned that Rockstar workers in the union will continue organizing even without formal recognition.

Voting ran from November 12th through 26th, covering the launch of GTA VI. If successful, the vote would have established a formal framework for collective negotiation with the studio over pay, overtime, bonuses, leave, and pensions, along with a right to consultation over future changes including AI implementation and layoffs. Without it, Rockstar won’t have an obligation to meet union representatives, though workers and union members can still lobby for change informally.

Sources indicate that “For anyone at Rockstar who believes in a fairer workplace, a fairer sector and a fairer society - this isn’t a sign to retreat, it’s a sign to double down on what we stand for,” IWGB remarked in a statement sent to The Verge. “Hundreds of our coworkers voted in favour of our union at Rockstar, yet sadly we recognise we have more work to do to build understanding and win the trust of more of our colleagues. We’re ready to put in the effort to make that happen.”.

When Rockstar fired 31 IWGB members last year, the union accused it of “the most blatant and ruthless act of union busting in the history of the games industry.” That case has gone to a UK employment tribunal, with a judgment still pending.

According to recent reports, “We are extraordinarily proud of our team, the culture we’ve built together and the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI,” Rockstar head of publishing Jennifer Kolbe told Bloomberg News. “This result reflects our team’s strong support for continuing the direct relationships, collaboration and open dialogue that have helped make Rockstar Games so innovative and strong. As we look ahead, we’re excited to build on all we’ve accomplished together.”.

If you're using the ongoing Black Friday sales to pick up a handset for someone a little clumsier than most, whether that's a teen or someone much older, then there's no reason to break the bank splashing out on something they might, well, break.

Recent findings suggest that that's why this entry-level smartphone from Motorola has my attention. The Moto G Play is on sale for just $99.99 at Amazon right now, a $50 price cut compared to its usual asking price. That's right, you can get a fully fledged smartphone from a major name brand for under 100 bucks right now, and it's even unlocked so it can be used with every carrier.

According to recent reports, what exactly do you get for that money? A basic, all-round phone geared towards day-to-day use cases like making calls and browsing social media or the web. No, it's nothing fancy, but I'd argue this actually works in its favor: this is a phone for keeping in touch rather than playing games all day.

This dirt-cheap smartphone is geared towards those with basic needs who just want something that enables them to keep in touch. Its specs are very basic, and the construction is plastic, but it still makes calls, can browse the web, and download apps all the same.

Industry observers note that ✅Recommended if: You want one of the cheapest phones available from a major brand. It does have some highlights, though, like the 90Hz refresh rate of its screen for a smoother feel and the presence of a 3.5mm headphone jack and microSD card slot.

  • Huawei has developed a design for high-bandwidth memory (HBM), the fast memory that feeds AI chips, that could outdo Samsung’s and SK Hynix’s, Bloomberg reported on Thursday.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

A Huawei sign on the side of a building in China.

Recent findings suggest that huawei is set to present a high-bandwidth memory design with double the data pin density of chips Samsung and SK Hynix mass-produce, Bloomberg reported. It is unclear how close Huawei is to making it, but home-grown HBM would ease a key gap as China’s foreign stockpiles run low.

Huawei has developed a design for high-bandwidth memory (HBM), the fast memory that feeds AI chips, that could outdo Samsung’s and SK Hynix’s, Bloomberg reported on Thursday.

According to the title of a paper Huawei will present in San Francisco in February, its HBM has double the data pin density of chips its Korean rivals mass-produce. In theory, that would let it move far more data to AI processors.

It is unclear how far Huawei has got. Companies often present designs at conferences to share ideas rather than show finished products. Huawei did not immediately respond to Bloomberg.

Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron are barred from selling HBM to Chinese customers, and China’s stocks of foreign HBM are running low. Huawei has reportedly told some clients its next Ascend AI chip will rely mostly on Korean HBM brought in by smugglers.

Sources indicate that making its own would ease one of the biggest gaps in China’s push for chip self-sufficiency. Chinese memory maker CXMT is also starting HBM production, despite low yields.

Industry observers note that huawei has already shown other workarounds for US sanctions. In June, it unveiled a chip design approach it notes could match 1.4nm-class chips by 2031 without the most advanced machines.

The report hit shares of Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron. Micron’s quarterly revenue roughly quadrupled earlier this year on demand for AI memory.

GTA 6: How to get more than $15,000 early on with almost no effort

📅 26 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 4 min read (824 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Mashable

⏱️ ~4 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Everyone's journey through Grand Theft Auto VI is going to go a little differently, as that's the nature of a massive, freeform open-world adventure.
  • Industry observers note that that's especially true at the beginning of chapter 2 of the game's main story.
  • Just understand that there may be some minor spoilers for the beginning of chapter 2 if you decide to read ahead.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Everyone's journey through Grand Theft Auto VI is going to go a little differently, as that's the nature of a massive, freeform open-world adventure. But one thing is certain for every player: You're going to need money, and fast.

Industry observers note that that's especially true at the beginning of chapter 2 of the game's main story. For reasons I won't spoil in case you aren't there yet, chapter 2 finds Jason and Lucia in a tough spot with almost no money to their names, and an urgent need to get some. Thankfully, there are a couple of different methods that, when combined, can net you somewhere between $15,000 and $20,000, with almost no killing or even any real effort required.

Just understand that there may be some minor spoilers for the beginning of chapter 2 if you decide to read ahead.

It has been revealed that we'll start with a method to get at least $10,000 (and possibly as much as $14,000), which we first learned about from GamingBible and tested ourselves to ensure it worked. Without beating around the bush, it does work.

Recent findings suggest that it involves going to an abandoned warehouse outside the town of Hamlet, which is easily accessible from the very beginning of the game. However, because (spoiler warning) you lose all of your held money at the end of chapter 1, I highly advise waiting until chapter 2 to do this.

In a recent development, anyway, you'll know you're in the right place if you follow the waypoint marker in the screenshot above and see a warehouse with an Apollo sign out front. There will be lots of vehicles and construction equipment outside, but don't worry, it's totally empty inside. Well, except for a bunch of rotting corpses and more than $10,000 worth of contraband lying around. Simply pick all of it up, stash it in the trunk of your car, and take it to a fence for a low-effort, no-risk payday.

Industry observers note that just make sure you have a fence available to you when you do this. You'll unlock one early in chapter 2, so perhaps you should work your way through a few main story missions at the beginning of the chapter before taking this on. It's also logistically a little easier to do this with both Jason and Lucia together, as there is a lot to carry in there, so maybe keep playing until that's an option, too.

Industry observers note that this second batch of cash is one we heard about from our friends at IGN, and, again, we can vouch for it ourselves. It's something you can only do after the start of chapter 2, but just to reiterate, you are pretty destitute with almost no money and no vehicles to your name at that point in the game. It's worth playing a couple of story missions to at least fix the vehicle problem first before doing this next bit of money-stealing.

Recent findings suggest that to be specific, there is a "rainy day fund" of $5,000 cash hidden in Jason's bedroom in his old house. Unfortunately, by this point in the game, that house has been exploded real good, and the entire neighborhood is a heat area where cops are stationed and looking for Jason and Lucia. It's a bit of a hike from where the story takes place in chapter 2, and it's in a risky spot, so this is a super easy wad of cash to miss.

Still, you can at least drive (or take a cab) down to the area outside the heat zone and go on foot from there. Do whatever you can to sneak to the backside of Jason's house and get inside. You can easily evade the cops if you stick to nearby backyards and maybe do a little bit of swimming. Just stay crouched and quiet, and you'll get in and out easily. Once you're in, go to Jason's old bedroom, open the stash, and grab the $5,000. You can also optionally grab some old photos while you're at it, which will raise Jason and Lucia's relationship rating.

If you do both of these things, which should take maybe half an hour of real-time at most, you can roll around in chapter 2 with as much as $19,000 in your account before you get started doing real crimes. Have fun, folks.

10 Best Office Chairs of 2026—We Tested 70 to Pick Them
